name: cx-sequence~p1
task: First find the key and then pick it up. After that, open the locked door, enter the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The clauses R2 Existence(has_matching_key) and R5 Existence(target_room_entered) are redundant — they only repeat what the hard Precedence chains already force. The task is a stated order chain: find key → pick it up → open door → enter room → pick up ball, correctly captured by the Precedence clauses plus the final Existence(target_picked_up), which forces the whole chain. Remove the redundant Existence(has_matching_key) and Existence(target_room_entered); keep the Precedence clauses and Existence(target_picked_up).

texts: The agent finds the key before picking it up.
The agent opens the locked door only after picking up the matching key.
The agent enters the target room only after opening the locked door.
The agent picks up the ball only after entering the target room.
The agent picks up the ball.
